why_it_moved.text: The mechanism is unknown; the scorecard has no segment cuts, so no cause for the Successful Search Rate gain can be named.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A comparison of Ranker v7 against a randomized control, registered as an A/B test with its own bar, would make the A/B rules apply.
An explanation of why the arms are split evenly when the holdout design planned a small control group would need to be settled first.
